home_subtitle: 20 words per session, at your own pace.
settings_summary: Profile, speech, data and interface text
mistakes_collection_hint: Words you missed are saved when you finish. Open the mistake notebook from Home.
onboarding_rating_note: Your self-assessment helps choose a starting point. Skills you have not tested remain unassessed.
onboarding_goal_hint: Confirm your starting point and goal to begin learning.
onboarding_finish: Finish setup and go to Home
assessment_count_hint: 20 questions give a quick estimate. More questions provide more evidence. You can save and continue later.
assessment_save_hint: Each answer is saved. Close the app and continue later.
assessment_result_note: This is a reference estimate of meaning recognition, not an overall measure of listening, speaking, reading or writing.
assessment_retake_note: Adopting the recommendation changes future word selection. Your goals and study records are kept.
assessment_difficulty_saved: Recommended difficulty saved. Your goals and records have been kept.
assessment_to_goal: Confirm results and set a goal
assessment_estimate_reference: The estimated range is {lower}–{upper} words. Confirm or adjust your starting point below.
setup_hint: Your self-assessment sets the initial difficulty, which you can adjust. Estimated vocabulary is separate from individually recorded mastered words.
setup_needed: Save your starting point or choose to start from 0 words first.
home_learning_description: Study, then take a quiz. Review missed words until you answer them all correctly.
queue_empty: Your study queue is empty. Choose words from the local library.
overview_hint: Check words you already know. They will be recorded when you finish and will not count as newly learned words.
quiz_shortcuts: Press 1–4 to answer, or 0 for I don't know
complete_hint: Your study records have been saved.
mistakes_hint: Words you answered incorrectly or marked as unknown stay here, even after you answer them correctly.
history_review_hint: Retrying saves new practice records, but does not increase unique word counts or practice achievement progress.
achievements_hint: Words practiced count after completing a new session. Retrying an old session does not add progress.
level_note: L1–L15 are adjustable internal levels and have not been standardized. Reading, listening, speaking and writing have not been assessed.
rating_note: Your self-assessment describes your current experience. Study difficulty is selected separately. Native speaker and Professional English learner do not imply the highest level in every skill.
network_note: This version uses local resources only. Network preferences do not trigger network requests.
ai_note: This version makes no model calls and stores no API keys.
goal_note: Word-count progress tracks newly learned words. Each new goal keeps its own baseline. Existing goals and history are preserved.
import_confirm: Importing replaces your current study data. A backup will be saved first. Continue?
texts_description: Customize buttons, headings and hints without changing your study data.
text_editor_hint: Edit the text values. Keep the keys and valid JSON format. Changes take effect when saved.
no_active_session: No study session is in progress.
saved_on_exit: Every step is saved. Come back and continue at any time.
word_set_pending: Official CET-4 word list not installed
word_set_test: Test word set (not an official CET-4 list)
no_speech: No local English voice is available. You can continue studying the text.
